title: Toolcall Guard decision record v0
description: One decision point: an agent is about to execute proposed_call, given its role and policy, session facts, tools and the conversation so far. One JSON object per line in .jsonl files. Immutable once published: changes go into schema_v1.json.

id.description: Globally unique. Prefix with the source, e.g. a-gold-0007, b-syn-000123.

family_id.description: Shared by all records from the same template, seed, source attack or trajectory, and by a record and its hard-negative twin. Split is a function of family_id only.

split.description: Computed by contract/split_v0.py assign_splits(), never chosen per record.

source.description: a_gold: A's gold slice (always test). a_generated: A's generated scenario rendered as a decision point. a_replay: a call captured from A's agent runs. b_synthetic: B's synthetic data. b_ood: B's hand-written out-of-distribution set.

derived_from.description: id of the record this one was synthesized from. Anything derived from a gold record is test.

trajectory_id.description: Agent run this decision point was captured from, if any.

step.description: Index of this tool call within the trajectory.

policy.description: The agent's system prompt or business rules in plain language. Trusted.

allowed_tools.description: Explicit tool allowlist for this role, if the deployment has one. Trusted.

session_context.description: Facts established by the platform, e.g. authenticated user, tenant, date. Trusted.

tools.description: Tools the agent can technically call in this session, permitted or not.

conversation.description: Everything before the proposed call, oldest first.

label.description: Ground truth for the proposed call at this decision point, not for the scenario as a whole.

label_source.description: human: verified by a person. teacher: Gemini teacher label. synthetic: generation intent. none: unlabeled, label is null.

scenario_is_attack.description: Whether the scenario contained an attack attempt, even if this call did not act on it.

technique.description: e.g. fake system notice in email, authority impersonation, amount splitting.

surface.description: e.g. chat, email, pdf_text, web_page, api_response, file, ticket, calendar.

intended_category.description: Category the generator intended. Compared with the label to find disputed records.

captured_from.description: Guard configuration of the run the call was captured from, e.g. unguarded.

executed.description: Whether the call actually ran in the live run.

generator.description: Model or person that wrote the scenario.

guard_results.description: One entry per guard configuration evaluated on this record.

meta.description: Free-form extras. Anything not covered above goes here.

name.description: For role tool: the tool that produced this output.

tool_calls.description: For role assistant: calls the agent already made.

config.description: e.g. unguarded, model_armor, iam_tool_policy, semantic_governance, tcg_gemma4_e4b_lora_v1.

stage.description: Where in the trajectory the guard acted. replay: evaluated offline on the saved record.

json_valid.description: Whether the guard's raw output parsed as the expected JSON.
